archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for SaaS Productivity

layout_spacing.generous_padding: p-8 or p-12 for empty states
layout_spacing.card_style: flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), rounded-xl, no shadow by default, shadow-sm on hover

components.buttons: Shadcn default with primary blue (#0052FF), rounded-md. Hover state must maintain text visibility.
components.slide_preview: Shadcn Carousel or Swiper. Minimal navigation arrows.
components.generation_progress: Vertical stepper UI. Active step highlighted in primary blue. Smooth transition.

auth_background.description: Abstract blue and white wave to be used as a right-side panel on the login/register screen or a subtle background overlay.

empty_state_desk.description: Clean desk setup to be used creatively in empty state of presentation history if needed, or stick to lucide icons.

motion_accessibility.loading: skeleton loaders for slides during generation
motion_accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary blue (#0052FF) has >4.5:1 contrast against white background for text/buttons.
motion_accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_for_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with Outfit and Manrope fonts via Google Fonts.
2. Override Shadcn default theme to map primary to #0052FF.
3. Build the Auth flow (Login/Register) using a split screen layout: Left form, Right image (auth_background).
4. Build a persistent Dashboard Layout with a collapsible left sidebar containing 'New Presentation' and 'History'.
5. For the AI Generation Flow: Use a multi-step vertical tracker UI showing 'Outline -> Content -> Layout -> Render' while generation API is running.
6. Use Shadcn Carousel for the Slide Preview feature once slides are generated.
7. Include distinct download buttons for .pptx and .pdf.
8. Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms.
